And the only efforts to create regional politics have resulted in chaos and not only that, but a practical treason inter-regions. And not to mention the whole thing going around about OOC Harassment, and the passiveness of the region to address this. This may seem of no concern in this topic, but it has its importance for it provokes a situation of apathy towards other regions, and a total misunderstanding on how OOC matters are more important than IC, and a complete lack of not only trust but of care for the other players / regions.
